profiles.title: Commit-time smoke gate
profiles.description: Blocking deterministic smoke coverage for local pre-commit verification.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote only deterministic, low-cost smoke cases that stay trustworthy at commit time.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that require relaxed invariants, repeated baseline refreshes, or too much artifact output for pre-commit use.

profiles.title: Push-time smoke confirmation
profiles.description: Blocking deterministic smoke coverage for post-push confirmation.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote only deterministic smoke cases that add clear post-push confidence without slowing feedback too much.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that become noisy, expensive, or dependent on advisory-only tolerances.

profiles.title: Release-candidate deterministic suite
profiles.description: Repository-owned replay coverage intended for release candidate sign-off.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote cases that stay stable enough to act as release-signoff evidence across core capabilities.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that keep drifting or require exploratory-only interpretation instead of release-candidate confidence.

profiles.title: Advisory context suite
profiles.description: Non-blocking context-heavy replay coverage for exploratory drift review.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote context cases into stricter profiles only after the drift they watch becomes deterministic enough for a blocking gate.
budget.demotion_policy: Keep exploratory or noisy context cases in advisory review until they stop requiring relaxed interpretation.
